endurance.chartHintTopTeam: The top {size} teams of the round shown; the others are hidden. Hover a team in the list to see its path; click or tap it to add it to “My selection”.
endurance.chartHintTopSolo: The top {size} players of the round shown; the others are hidden. Hover a player in the list to see their path; click or tap them to add them to “My selection”.
endurance.chartHintPickTeam: {count, plural, one {# team selected} other {# teams selected}} — {max} at most. Click in the list or on a line to add or remove.
endurance.chartHintPickSolo: {count, plural, one {# player selected} other {# players selected}} — {max} at most. Click in the list or on a line to add or remove.
endurance.chartHintPickEmptyTeam: Click teams in the list or on the lines to compare them ({max} at most).
endurance.chartHintPickEmptySolo: Click players in the list or on the lines to compare them ({max} at most).
endurance.chartHintAllTeam: Every team in colour — handy for a screenshot, harder to read.
endurance.chartHintAllSolo: Every player in colour — handy for a screenshot, harder to read.
endurance.chartHintWrapTeam: Beyond {max} teams in colour, colours repeat: the list and the details panel tell them apart.
endurance.chartHintWrapSolo: Beyond {max} players in colour, colours repeat: the list and the details panel tell them apart.
endurance.chartPickMaxTeam: Selection full: {max} teams at most. Remove one to add another.
endurance.chartPickMaxSolo: Selection full: {max} players at most. Remove one to add another.
endurance.chartSvgTeam: Endurance of {count, plural, one {# team} other {# teams}}, from the start to round {round}.
endurance.chartSvgSolo: Endurance of {count, plural, one {# player} other {# players}}, from the start to round {round}.
endurance.chartInfoEmptyTeam: Pick a round to see the chart at that stage; hover a line or a team to see its path. Hollow circle: the team has not played the round shown.
endurance.chartInfoEmptySolo: Pick a round to see the chart at that stage; hover a line or a player to see their path. Hollow circle: the player has not played the round shown.
endurance.chartTableCaptionTeam: Endurance of each team, round by round
endurance.chartTableCaptionSolo: Endurance of each player, round by round
